data.notes: Berlin’s November 2026 calendar is already strong on confirmed arena-scale pop/electronic tours, Jazzfest Berlin, and music-industry showcases, while most late-night club lineups are not yet announced this far out.

events.title: Jazzfest Berlin 2026
events.venueName: Haus der Berliner Festspiele and other venues
events.summary: Berliner Festspiele confirms Jazzfest Berlin 2026 for 29 October to 1 November at Haus der Berliner Festspiele and other locations. The 2026 programme is not yet fully announced, but the dates and festival edition are confirmed.

events.title: Most Wanted: Music 2026
events.summary: Berlin Music Commission confirms MW:M26 for 3–5 November 2026 in Berlin. The event combines music-business conference programming with MW:M Live showcases and the Listen to Berlin Awards ecosystem.

events.title: Dabeull Live Band in Berlin
events.summary: Tempodrom lists Dabeull Live Band for 3 November 2026, with doors at 19:00 and show start at 20:00. The French producer brings an analog live-band format focused on funk, retro synths and groove-led electronic music.

events.title: Tokio Hotel
events.summary: Uber Arena confirms Tokio Hotel for 7 November 2026 in Berlin. The German pop band is booked for a large-scale arena show with a 20:00 start.

events.title: Enter Shikari + Holding Absence + The Callous Daoboys
events.summary: Enter Shikari’s official tour page confirms the Lose Your Self Tour 2026 at Columbiahalle on 7 November 2026. Holding Absence and The Callous Daoboys are listed as supports.

events.title: Jungle
events.summary: Uber Arena confirms London neo-soul group Jungle for 8 November 2026 in Berlin. The venue page lists Rio Kosta as special guest and a 20:00 show start.

events.title: Bloc Party & Interpol
events.summary: Uber Arena confirms the Bloc Party and Interpol co-headline show for 11 November 2026. The venue lists doors at 18:00 and show start at 19:15.

events.title: Hatsune Miku: MIKU EXPO 2026 EUROPE
events.summary: Velodrom confirms Hatsune Miku’s MIKU EXPO 2026 EUROPE stop for 17 November 2026. The listing describes the show as a live production with band, light show and animated choreography.

events.title: Apsilon: Glanz Null Tour
events.summary: Apsilon’s official shop confirms the Glanz Null Tour stop at Columbiahalle on 19 November 2026. The Berlin rapper’s event page lists doors at 18:30 and start at 20:00.

events.title: The Prodigy: The European Tour 2026
events.summary: Trinity Music confirms The Prodigy at Velodrom on 21 November 2026. It is the Berlin stop of the band’s European Tour 2026.

events.title: Grossstadtgeflüster: 23 2/3 Jahre Jubiläumstour 2026
events.summary: Greyzone’s ticket page confirms Berlin electro-pop band Grossstadtgeflüster at Columbiahalle on 26 November 2026. The show is part of the band’s 23 2/3-year anniversary tour.

events.title: Fatoni: Drama endet nie Tour 2026
events.summary: Loft Concerts confirms Fatoni at Columbiahalle on 28 November 2026 for the Drama endet nie Tour. The German rapper’s tour is presented with new material and a best-of component.
